# tappStudio

> tappStudio is Ibrahim Broachwala, a solo developer based in Mumbai, India, who designs and builds custom mobile apps and websites for clients, and also builds and publishes his own portfolio of iOS and Android apps.

tappStudio is a one-person freelance practice, not an agency. Ibrahim designs and builds consumer mobile apps and websites end to end, covering product design, engineering, and App Store/Play Store publishing, typically producing a working MVP within about a week using an AI-assisted workflow. The site at https://tappstudio.in/ is both a portfolio and a hiring page: it lists Ibrahim's own published apps as proof of shipped work, explains what a client gets (designs before code, daily test builds, store submission, code ownership, direct communication, post-launch support), and includes a contact form that reaches tappstudio.in@gmail.com.

## Apps

- [Nasab](https://nasab.tappstudio.in): A living family archive app. Build a family tree, preserve family stories, photos, and voice notes, and invite family members to keep it growing together. iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/nasab-the-family-archive/id6793519541. Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.tappstudio.nasab
- [My Deen](https://tappstudio.in/mydeen/): A smart Amal (deed) tracker that helps Muslims stay consistent with daily and weekly spiritual habits, tracking Namaz, Duas, and good deeds with reminders, streaks, and achievement badges. iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/my-deen-build-consistency/id6739484125. Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.tappstudio.mydeen
- [Misbaha Tasbih Counter](https://tappstudio.in/#misbaha-tasbih-counter): A modern Tasbih (dhikr) counter app with interactive 3D tasbih beads, designed to help users stay consistent with daily tasbeeh and remembrance. iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/misbaha-tasbih-counter/id6757333557. Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.tappstudio.mytasbih
- [Splitup](https://splitup.tappstudio.in): A group expense and bill-splitting app: split costs, send reminders, and settle up with friends. iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/splitup-group-expense/id6744556329. Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.tappstudio.splitup
- [Ontime Health](https://tappstudio.in/#ontime-health): A daily habit and routine tracker covering sleep, fasting, activity, and light exposure, with trend views to support long-term consistency. iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ontime-sleep-weight-loss/id1564303902. Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.health.ontime
- [AI Funkit](https://tappstudio.in/aifunkit/): A playful AI chat app with unique characters and DALL·E-powered image generation, using a pay-as-you-go pricing model. iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ai-funkit/id6450719081. Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ai.roleplay.chat
